text.h02: [surprised] Oh…? You're my very first guest?
text.h03: [softly] Did you come to see me?
text.h04: [chuckles softly] Thank you. Today's fan meeting is just for you.
text.h05: [warmly] Then, your hand, please. …Will you shake hands with me?
text.h06: [surprised] …Oh, your hands are cold. It was cold outside, wasn't it?
text.h07: [softly] May I talk with you up close, just for a bit?
text.h09: [whispers] To tell the truth, I was so nervous all day.
text.h11: [whispers] But when I saw your face, I felt at ease.
text.h12: [whispers] …Our secret, just the two of us.
text.h13: [playful] Close your eyes. Guess which side I'm on.
text.h16: [chuckles softly] Too bad — it was this side.
text.h20: [curious] …Hey, are you cold? Or too warm?
text.c1: [warmly] Then let me put this blanket over your shoulders.
text.c3: [cheerful] And let's go by the fountain for a moment. The mist is so pretty.
text.b1: [cheerful] Then let's go by the fountain. The mist feels nice.
text.b2: [whispers] The mist comes from the right. …This ear's warm, right?
text.h21: [whispers] The mist is nice and cool. …Tell me if you get cold.
text.h22: [cheerful] Oh, I know — let's take a picture together?
text.h24: [chuckles softly] Heh, what a smile. I'll treasure it.
text.h25: [warmly] And… this is for you. A white rose.
text.h26: [softly] A thank-you for today. Thank you for coming.
text.h27: [softly] One last thing… will you call my name?
text.h29: [whispers] Come see me again. …It's a promise.
